summary: `/ventures/<alias>` redirects (307) to the UUID URL instead of serving the alias URL
expected: A readable alias stays in the address bar so links shared by humans read `v-crous-queue`.
actual: GET /ventures/v-crous-queue → 307 Location: /ventures/f0b5abfe-0274-42f7-9c9a-72dcbe68c116. The CLI resolves the alias fine.
reproduction: Set an alias with `venture alias`; open /ventures/<alias> in the console.
impact: Cosmetic: humans still see the UUID in links and bookmarks.
suggestion: Serve the page at the alias URL (or redirect UUID → alias once an alias exists).
